label: Apple Mac mini (M2)
description: Compact desktop with Apple M2, Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 standard (10GbE a build option) plus Wi-Fi 6E.
notes: 1GbE RJ45 is standard on the M2 mini; the 10GbE option is a configure-to-order upgrade, so the default node links at 1G. Wi-Fi 6E + BT 5.3 also onboard - dual-homed host for redundancy tests.
